description: Port of Ruff's F504 (percent-format-extra-named-arguments): a valid `%`-format string without positional placeholders applied to a dict display without `**` with a string-literal key no `%(key)` placeholder names. `formatArgs` reads the format string left of `%` (a str literal with no f/t/b prefix, implicit concatenations joined, escapes decoded, parentheses transparent) with the `percentFormat` grammar (a port of ruff_python_literal's cformat parser), and the right operand as Ruff's strings.rs does.
